adr.title: Context-Preserving Document Text Processing Pipeline
adr.context: Users need to improve text in standardized procurement documents by correcting errors and aligning wording with technical-legal norms. They also need to reformulate, summarize, or expand content without changing the context or purpose of the resulting artifact. These varied text-processing tasks need to work together across different standardized document types.
adr.decision: We will process document text through a sequence of separable transformation stages. The stages will perform correction, technical-legal adjustment, and the user-requested reformulation, summarization, or expansion as appropriate. Each stage will pass its result to the next while preserving the text’s context and the artifact’s purpose.
adr.consequences: Separating the transformations will make it easier to modify or add text-processing steps than in a single, combined process. However, the stages will need to work together so that successive changes do not alter the document’s context or purpose.
